news.analysis: With Mayfield dealing with a foot injury, the Bucs are bringing in Rush as extra depth. It's safe to assume Jalon Daniels would be the starter if Mayfield misses time, and Rush would be the backup in that situation.
news.contents: Cooper Rush is signing with the Tampa Bay practice squad due to the injury to Baker Mayfield.
news.title: Cooper Rush signs with Tampa Bay practice squad

news.contents: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield (foot, ankle) used a walking boot during the Week 10 bye after getting hurt against the Chicago Bears, NFL Network's Mike Garafolo reported Sunday. Garafolo said any absence would likely be brief, with Mayfield's status uncertain for Sunday's game at Detroit.
